description: Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs - Amendment to the Extra Gazette No. 1990/23 of 27.10.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification contains amendments to regulations under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973, specifically modifying the National Association of Sports Regulations. It involves legal/regulatory matters - amending existing regulations, repealing and inserting specific dates, and specifying when the amended provisions come into force. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and modifications to existing legal instruments.
